en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Hilal who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws was asked about the clothes which happen to be dyed with saffron, then it is washed, ‘Can I wear it and I am in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. The saffron is not from the perfumes, but Iasws dislike it if you were to wear what makes you to be prominent among the people’.
en.sarwar: 17. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the cloth which is stained with saffron and it then is washed but it (the stain) does not go away; if it can be used for Ihram.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful if its smell is gone; even if all of it is colored which has become of a whitish color, when washed; then it is not harmful.’”
